component.name: qiptv
component.summary: Native Qt IPTV client for Xtream Codes providers

description.p: qiptv is a native Qt desktop application for watching IPTV content delivered through the Xtream Codes API. Log in with your provider's server URL and credentials to browse Live TV, Movies and Series, with libmpv-powered playback and hardware decoding.

ul.li: Live TV, Movies (VOD) and Series browsing by category
Multiple saved provider profiles with auto-login
libmpv playback with seeking, volume and fullscreen
Channel zapping, media-key control and system-tray integration

description.p: Initial release: Xtream Codes browsing and libmpv playback.
